content:
I built a GPU-native implementation of CIC type checking for Lean4. It processes real Lean4 expression trees (exported via metaprogramming) and type-checks them entirely on CUDA.

Results on RTX 4070 Laptop:

  • Type checking: 126M proofs/sec
    • WHNF reduction (beta/delta/zeta): 103M proofs/sec
    • Definitional equality: 394M eq checks/sec
    • Real Lean4 theorems (Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_assoc, etc.): 6/6 verified
      Use case: batch verification backend for AI proof search — when a neural prover generates 10K candidate proofs, GPU can validate them all in <1ms instead of seconds on CPU.

Repo: https://github.com/Tehlikeli107/cuda-cic

Current limitations: subset of CIC (no universe polymorphism or full iota reduction yet). Feedback and contributions welcome.
